description: For flooring installation, this inspection checklist records layout, acclimation, substrate preparation, moisture limits, adhesive, expansion, sequencing, and protection. Its supporting evidence includes moisture test, flatness readings, lot record, layout approval, installation photos, and seam or lippage checks.

use_case: Use the inspection checklist during flooring installation readiness and acceptance when the flooring installation record must identify room, substrate, flooring product and lot, transitions, moisture-sensitive areas, furniture, and adjacent finishes. Complete the applicable handoff for finish inspection, protection plan, care instructions, attic-stock handoff, warranty, and customer acceptance.
